runs.text:
Within Temptation is the legendary leader of dark anthemic music, captivating audiences for three decades with their powerful soundscapes. With a career spanning eight studio albums, their discography includes the groundbreaking releases Enter [1997], Mother Earth [2000], The Silent Force [2004], The Heart of Everything [2007], The Unforgiving [2011], Hydra [2014], RESIST [2019] and BLEED OUT [2023]. With more than 4 million record sales to their name, they have firmly established themselves as one of the world's most successful heavy rock groups.

Within Temptation's work has been recognized with numerous international awards, including a World Music Award, MTV Europe Music Awards, and a Metal Hammer Award,. The band's songs have amassed millions of streams and in support of their albums, Within Temptation have nearly sold out their past tours, such as the 'WORLDS COLLIDE' co-headlining tour with Evanescence and the band's latest 'Bleed Out 2024 Tour' across Europa and the UK!
